GOOD QUESTIONS

A few things
you might wonder.

More questions, answered
Can I book cleaning and removals together?
Absolutely. Tell us about your move and the clean you need. We’ll discuss access, timing and availability, then put together a quote covering both services.
Which areas do you cover?
We’re based in Belfast and work across the city and surrounding areas. Send us your postcode—or both postcodes for a move—and we’ll confirm whether we can help.
How much does it cost?
Our advertised cleaning rate is £25 per hour. The total depends on your property and the work involved. Removals are quoted individually, based on the items, journey and access. We’ll confirm the scope and price with you before booking.
Do I need to be at home?
Let us know what suits you. We can discuss access arrangements when planning your clean. For removals, we’ll agree who will be present at collection and delivery.
